history.description: Release Integrity v0.20.1 correction revision 4: preserve all prior functional fixes while making the incremental update path stable. Workflow files are manually bootstrapped once and are permanently forbidden inside update ZIPs; the root ZIP remains until validation passes; final status is reported only after commit/push.

Data Safety and Browser Matrix v0.20.2 correction revision 7: preserve the validated recovery, offline, Presentations control-state and functional-acceptance fixes. This revision changes no application runtime code; it removes one stale CHECKSUMS.sha256 entry for shared/vendor/pdfjs/README.md, which is absent from the real v0.20.1 repository tree. Hosted validation already passed 210/210 unit tests and 11/11 Chromium browser regressions before stopping only at this checksum-tree mismatch.

Functional Corrections v0.20.2.1 correction revision 2: fixes the two hosted browser-validation failures without changing the release target or workflow. Cross-workspace isolation now reads the editable Spreadsheet/Presentation title inputs correctly, and the PDF viewer safely ignores delayed resize work when no PDF document is active.

Refactoring Guardrails v0.20.2.2 correction 2: remove the stale checksum entry for shared/vendor/pdfjs/README.md, which the hosted v0.20.2.1 tree proves is absent, and add a fail-fast checksum-manifest regression to the unit suite. No application runtime or workflow file is changed.

Presentations decomposition v0.20.2.3: behavior-neutral extraction of the Format/Inspector state and property-control handlers from apps/presentations/app.js into apps/presentations/ui/inspector-controller.js. The existing visual contract, editing behavior, offline shell, recovery semantics and stable workflow remain unchanged.

Presentations decomposition v0.20.2.4: behavior-neutral extraction of slide-thumbnail rendering/visibility and presenter-notes rendering/input/visibility from apps/presentations/app.js into focused UI controllers. No visual redesign, editing feature, PPTX behavior, recovery behavior or workflow change is intended.

Presentations decomposition v0.20.2.5: behavior-neutral extraction of selected-object state, drag/resize/rotate interactions, and Undo/Redo history into focused state controllers. No visual redesign, editing feature, PPTX behavior, save/recovery behavior or workflow change is intended.

Presentations decomposition v0.20.2.6, correction 2: runtime and slideshow extraction are unchanged. The hosted correction-1 run passed repository validation, source audit, architecture guardrails, all 236 unit/package tests, and 11/12 Chromium scripts. The sole failure was in the Presentations browser harness: previous View-tab checks left Home tools hidden before the new slideshow scenario clicked New slide. This correction restores the Home tab in the test before clicking #addSlideBtn. No application runtime, UI, behavior, workflow, release version, or sequence change is intended.

Update-flow hardening v0.20.2.7 correction 1. Runtime and updater behavior are unchanged. The hosted run passed repository validation, source audit, architecture guardrails and all 242 unit/package tests; 12/13 Chromium scripts passed. The sole failure was an isolated slideshow harness assumption: after 'From first', the legacy editor state is slide one, so a later 'From current' scenario must explicitly re-select slide two. The browser harness now establishes editor slide state before every current-slide entry. No editor runtime, UI, save/recovery, workflow, release version or sequence change is intended.

Presentations I/O and recovery decomposition: PPTX open/save orchestration, imported source-buffer ownership, copy download lifecycle and IndexedDB recovery adapter move from app.js into focused io controllers. No visual redesign or intentional format behavior change.
Presentations architecture consolidation: move package-preserving PPTX write/patch helpers into a dedicated I/O adapter, tighten the app.js ratchet, and preserve the established UI/file behavior.

PDF page-rendering decomposition: move page virtualization, PDF.js canvas/text/AcroForm rendering, rendered-page disposal and resize rerender behind a focused viewer controller while preserving the existing PDF UI, navigation, review and unified-save behavior.

PDF navigation decomposition v0.20.2.11 correction 1. Application runtime is unchanged. The hosted attempt passed repository validation, source audit, architecture guardrails, all 246 unit/package tests and 14/15 Chromium scripts. The sole failure was the new isolated PDF navigation harness clicking an outline tab while the shared workspace layout correctly kept the PDF navigation sidebar collapsed by default. The harness now asserts the default-closed state, explicitly opens the sidebar before using its tabs, and verifies a close/reopen round-trip.

PDF review decomposition: isolate local review persistence, selected-text review tools, free annotation overlays, comment rendering and review Undo behind focused PDF review components without changing the visible PDF workflow or unified Save behavior.

PDF Save Decomposition v0.20.2.13 correction 1. Application runtime is unchanged. The hosted attempt passed repository validation, source audit, architecture guardrails, all 248 unit/package tests and 16/17 Chromium scripts. The sole failure was a race in the new isolated PDF Save harness: it treated PDF.js pageCount availability as completion of the whole asynchronous openFile transaction, while Save is intentionally enabled only after the initial page/navigation/review setup completes. The harness now waits for the Save button to become enabled before exercising save behavior.

Shared Document Session Decomposition v0.20.2.14 correction 1. The application runtime and the architectural extraction are unchanged. The first hosted attempt stopped in the workflow package-selection bootstrap before any transaction because the ZIP omitted files/scripts/apply_update_package.py. Correction 1 restores the mandatory updater bootstrap (and the unchanged browser-regression runner) to the package payload. No runtime, UI, file-format, save-path or workflow behavior change is introduced.

Shared workspace-panel decomposition: move existing Documents navigation-panel state, Presentations thumbnails/Format/notes panel state, PDF navigation-sidebar state and Spreadsheet layout markers behind shared/ui/workspace-panel-controller.js. The Documents ruler remains in workspace-layout.js. No visible control, panel default, editing behavior, file-format behavior, save path or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

Documents ruler-model decomposition: move existing pure ruler tick, page-geometry and indentation calculations behind shared/ui/document-ruler-model.js while workspace-layout.js retains DOM synchronization, observers and pointer interaction. Compatibility ruler-helper methods remain exposed from InkDeskWorkspaceLayout. No visible control, DOCX behavior, save behavior, panel behavior or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

Documents ruler interaction decomposition: move the existing pointer-drag lifecycle, pointer capture, drag-state transitions and indentation-application orchestration from shared/ui/workspace-layout.js into shared/ui/document-ruler-drag-controller.js. Ruler DOM synchronization/rendering and observers remain in workspace-layout.js; pure ruler geometry remains in document-ruler-model.js. No visible control, DOCX behavior, save behavior, panel behavior or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

Shared workspace contract consolidation: move workspace module detection, session-backed panel preference resolution and workspace-layout-ready notification ownership into shared/ui/workspace-panel-controller.js. shared/ui/workspace-layout.js preserves its compatibility API through delegation and remains responsible for Documents ruler DOM synchronization; it drops below the normal 500-line ceiling and leaves grandfathered architecture debt. No visible UI, file-format, save, recovery or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

TXT editor interaction decomposition: move Plain Text Undo/Redo snapshot history into apps/txt/history-controller.js and Find bar/search interaction into apps/txt/find-controller.js. apps/txt/app.js retains file lifecycle, encoding, line-ending preservation, Save, counts, wrap and text-size controls and falls below the normal 500-line ceiling. No visible UI, file-format, save, dirty-state or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

Spreadsheet formula model decomposition: move deterministic formula syntax, function metadata, cell/reference encoding, balancing, suggestion matching/insertion and reference/commit predicates into apps/spreadsheets/formula-model.js. formula-editor.js retains persistent drafts, DOM/caret interaction, suggestion UI and reference-controller integration. Public helper API and visible behavior are preserved.

Spreadsheet formula session lifecycle decomposition: move persistent draft storage and start/update/suspend/resume/commit/cancel state transitions into apps/spreadsheets/formula-session.js. formula-editor.js retains DOM/caret synchronization, suggestion rendering, keyboard routing and formula-reference integration. No visible behavior is intentionally changed.

Spreadsheet formula draft safety hardening: pending formula drafts participate in workbook safety guards, Save cannot silently omit a pending draft, confirmed workbook replacement clears draft state only after replacement parsing succeeds, and the behavior is covered by deterministic plus Chromium regressions.

Spreadsheet formula recovery hardening: uncommitted formula drafts are serialized into private recovery snapshots and restored as resumable drafts; confirmed workbook replacement discards prior recovery only after parsing succeeds; shared local-recovery writes are fenced by document generation so stale asynchronous writes cannot cross document boundaries.

Spreadsheet history safety hardening: Undo/Redo actions are bound to their originating worksheet, workbook recalculation follows history restoration, pending formula drafts guard history mutation, and private recovery schema v3 preserves bounded Undo/Redo state across restored sessions.

Local recovery source-continuity hardening: Save-copy cleanup clears stale snapshots while retaining the active source package for later edits, so a subsequent recovery can restore against the original OOXML package instead of a blank reconstruction. Recovery inspection removes orphaned clean-session sources, and browser coverage exercises save -> continue editing -> restore -> re-export fidelity.

Spreadsheet export-confirmation safety hardening plus release-note repository organization. Recovery is flushed before XLSX download dispatch, unverified browser download requests retain dirty/recovery protection, and historical RELEASE_NOTES_*.md files move from the repository root into docs/releases/ with an enforced index.

Recovery-source continuity hardening across tabs and cleanup races. Active imported source data can rehydrate a missing IndexedDB source before a new recovery snapshot; fresh source-only records receive an orphan grace period; snapshot cleanup is race-aware. Public release metadata and the Home shell are synchronized and permanently checked against VERSION.json.

Documents replacement transaction safety hardening. Dirty DOCX replacement now requires explicit confirmation before parsing starts; cancellation preserves the active unsaved document, and confirmed replacement remains transactional so parse failure restores the complete previous unsaved state. Existing transactional Chromium coverage now exercises both paths.

Cross-workspace unverified export safety hardening v0.20.2.29 correction 2. Application runtime is unchanged. Hosted validation again passed repository validation, source audit, architecture guardrails and all 330 unit/package tests, with 16/17 Chromium scripts passing. The remaining failure was traced to an invalid aggregate-harness selector: Documents renders editor pages under #pagesHost, while the harness waited for #pages .page-content, an element tree that does not exist. Correction 2 changes the aggregate harness to synchronize on statusText containing opened, then waits for #pagesHost .page-content to be attached and edits the first paragraph through the same #pagesHost root. No application runtime file changes.

Recovery session isolation hardening. IndexedDB recovery snapshots are owned by documentKey plus per-manager sessionId, so discard/reset/clean in one tab cannot remove another tab's unsaved recovery for the same Office file. Documents and Presentations discard only their own prior recovery after a committed replacement; restored snapshots are re-homed into the restoring session. Parsers, writers and visual behavior are unchanged. Correction 1 synchronizes Chromium regressions with the transactional asynchronous New flows introduced by this release; runtime files are unchanged.

Recovery prompt startup isolation hardening. Asynchronous IndexedDB recovery inspection is bound to a prompt epoch plus the active document generation/key, and Documents, Spreadsheets and Presentations explicitly cancel a pending prompt before user-initiated New/Open transitions. Deferred snapshots are preserved for a later clean launch. Parsers, writers, formulas and visual layout are unchanged.

Visual Foundation. Freezes v0.20.2.31 as the structural/data-safety baseline and adds a last-loaded shared presentation layer for Home and all six workspaces. Standardizes typography, 44 px titlebar chrome, control states, start surfaces, responsive launcher cards, coarse-pointer behavior and reduced-motion handling while preserving product identities. Parsers, writers, recovery semantics, formulas, history and transactional document logic are unchanged apart from release identity/cache metadata.

Content Workspaces Visual Pass. Builds on the validated v0.20.3.0 visual foundation with a last-loaded presentation-only layer for Documents, Plain Text and EPUB. Refines Documents toolbar/sidebar/page hierarchy, TXT writing surfaces and EPUB reader/navigation hierarchy while preserving the v0.20.2.31 structural/data-safety baseline. No parser, writer, recovery, formula, history, transactional document-state or workflow behavior is intentionally changed.

Content Workspaces Visual Pass correction revision 2. Replaces the failed revision 1 without consuming a new update sequence. It preserves the v0.20.2.31 data-safety baseline and application version 0.20.3.1, retains all intended visual changes from revision 1, and fixes the PDF start-screen CSS cascade so the hidden empty state cannot intercept navigation controls after a PDF is opened. No parser, writer, recovery, formula, history, or workflow logic is changed. Sequence remains 36 because the prior transaction rolled back and the repository remains on sequence 35.

Visual polish pass 3. Standardizes 34 px workspace status bars after the Spreadsheets pattern; anchors the PDF titlebar/content/statusbar to the dynamic viewport so the top and bottom chrome remain visible on iPad; removes the long redundant PDF save note from the status bar; separates the Presentations thumbnail rail from the slide stage without overlay shadow/rounding and keeps its status bar in the viewport; aligns the Spreadsheets titlebar into the same three-zone geometry as Documents; and compacts the EPUB reading toolbar for coarse-pointer/touch layouts. No parser, writer, recovery, formula, history, transactional document-state, storage, export-format, or workflow logic is changed.

UI unification pass 4. Makes Documents the visual shell reference across editing workspaces while leaving the Launcher responsive behavior unchanged; reserves a stable Spreadsheets footer; standardizes bottom zoom controls as minus, slider, plus, Fit and percentage across Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, PDF, TXT and EPUB; keeps only the PDF command toolbar centered; makes Presentations thumbnails and the PDF navigation rail consume real layout columns so they push content instead of overlaying it; turns EPUB page-theme choices into small toolbar-integrated circles; and adopts an iPad-landscape baseline that expands workspace area and spacing on 16:9, 20:9 and ultrawide displays without scaling controls. Spreadsheet formula/grid/sheet-tab logic, parsers, writers, recovery, history, storage, export formats and transactional document state are unchanged.

UI shell fidelity pass 5 correction 1. Replaces the failed sequence-39 candidate without consuming a new sequence. The hosted run passed 365/365 unit/package tests and 19/20 Chromium regressions; the sole failure showed that the fidelity overlay had inadvertently changed the Documents reference sidebar from its established 238 px (200 px at narrow viewport) to 250 px. This correction restores the validated Documents geometry and keeps Documents as the untouched visual reference while retaining the intended titlebar, toolbar, fixed sidebar, statusbar and wide-workspace refinements in Spreadsheets, Presentations, PDF, TXT and EPUB. PDF remains the only centered command bar. No parser, writer, recovery, formula, history, storage, export-format, transactional document-state, launcher, or workflow logic is changed.

UI correction pass 6. Preserves the approved Documents, TXT and EPUB shells while fixing the remaining iPad-landscape regressions: Spreadsheets keeps its bottom worksheet strip fully visible and restores an Add worksheet control; newly added worksheets are appended safely to imported XLSX packages and survive save/reopen without rebuilding or discarding existing workbook parts. PDF navigation keeps Pages, Index, Bookmarks and Comments fully readable in a Documents-like pushed sidebar. Presentations removes the redundant View-tab zoom strip in favor of the shared bottom zoom and normalizes the top presentation icons. The Launcher keeps its current proportions but pins runtime-generated icon, text and arrow into stable columns so card text aligns correctly in both landscape and smartphone views. Parsers, recovery semantics, formula drafts, history behavior, storage, existing export preservation and workflow logic are otherwise unchanged.
